name: artificearcondicionado.com.br
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name.
lesson: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.
summary: artificearcondicionado.com.br scores 88 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 18 are at risk, and 47 pass. Fix first: elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 7 elements on /, /vrf-vrv-sao-paulo, /instalacao-de-ar-condicionado-sp, for example .hdr__in > .brand[href="/"] and .hero__scroll. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Start the aria-label with the words that are visible on the control.

fix.title: The largest element paints after 4.6 s
fix.evidence: Measured once in Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) with no network throttling. A phone on mobile data will be slower.
fix.fix: Serve the hero image in a modern format at the shown size, preload it, and cut render-blocking scripts.

fix.title: 6 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.evidence: / (79), /vrf-vrv-sao-paulo (83), /instalacao-de-ar-condicionado-sp (84), /infraestrutura-de-ar-condicionado-sp (91) and 2 more. Google cuts them with an ellipsis.
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 6 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

fix.title: No privacy notice is linked
fix.evidence: None of the 6 pages analyzed, nor the rendered start page, links a privacy notice, yet the site has 1 form. Visitors cannot see who handles their data or why.
fix.fix: Publish a privacy notice that names who controls the data, what is collected, why, and the visitor's rights, and link it from the footer of every page.

fix.title: Visits from Google Maps are not told apart in analytics
fix.evidence: The profile's website link has no UTM tags, so analytics counts a tap on Website in Maps as an ordinary Google search or a direct visit.
fix.fix: Add utm_source=google&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=business-profile to the profile's website link.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Large images are served as WebP, AVIF or SVG
Every external link that was checked answered
